_comment: Curve presets for difficulty scaling (Round 127 方向1: 成长曲线). Each curve maps a 1-based wave index to a multiplier applied to the base stat. Identity returns 1.0 (no scaling). Linear preserves the legacy 1 + (wave-1) * coef formula. Other shapes let designers shape difficulty rhythm: exponential for compounding pressure, logarithmic for front-loaded growth, sigmoid for smooth ramp-up to a plateau, piecewise for hand-tuned inflection points.
